newsitem.title: USA: Knight-Ridder says parties eyeing info unit.
newsitem.headline: Knight-Ridder says parties eyeing info unit.

text.p: Anthony Ridder, Chairman of Knight-Ridder Inc, said four parties have so far approached the company's investment bankers regarding the potential purchase of Knight-Ridder's information unit.
The unit, Knight-Ridder Information Inc, was put on the block as a result of the parent company's decision to acquire four newspapers from Walt Disney Co.
He said the parties are both domestic and international companies, though Ridder declined to identify them.
He also declined to charecterize any negotiations or say what kind of price Knight-Ridder is seeking for the business.
Ridder said he expects the sale of the unit by the end of 1997.
One analyst, Philip Olesen of UBS Securities, has said the information unit could fetch close to $400 million.
Goldman Sachs is handling the potential transaction for Knight-Ridder.
